anomalies.description: Pay-if-paid: Owner payment is an express condition precedent to any progress or final payment, and Subcontractor assumes the risk of Owner nonpayment, insolvency or delay.

anomalies.description: Fallback clause states that if Section 5.2 is limited it is to be construed to postpone payment for the longest period permitted; the actual payment date is therefore uncertain.

anomalies.description: Payment is conditioned on waivers being 'received and approved' by Contractor, with no standard for approval. Incomplete applications may also be held without liability.
